name: codex-dsh-web
description: Drive and verify DSH Web sessions from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks to local DSH Web sessions.
interface.longDescription: Create DSH Web sessions with automatically enforced task-appropriate permissions, select and verify the exact active session in Codex Desktop's live UI, inspect results, and feed Codex verification back into the same session.
defaultPrompt: Open DSH Web in Codex's built-in browser and confirm the local service is reachable.
Open DSH Web in the built-in browser, automatically use workspace-write for my implementation task, select the exact newly created session even if the sidebar is collapsed, and verify the changes.
Open the existing DSH Web session in the built-in browser, select and verify its exact title, then continue the task.
